claims: Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission of the Artemis program.
Artemis II is scheduled to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
Artemis II is a 10-day test flight.
Artemis II aims to validate the Orion spacecraft and SLS rocket systems.
Artemis II is the first human lunar flyby since 1972.
Artemis II's mission goal is to test the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
The Artemis II mission uses the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The Artemis II mission uses the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission is launched from Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew includes NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch.
The Artemis II crew includes Canadian Space Agency (CSA) astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission will take the crew around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission will reach a distance of over 252,000 miles from Earth.
The European Service Module provides power and propulsion to the Orion spacecraft
